Definition: Kore, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Kore = "crier"; 1) a Korahite Levite, ancestor of Shallum and Meshelemiah, chief porters in the reign of David; 2) a Levite, son of Imnah, in the reign of king Hezekiah of Judah
